request.prompt: Title theme for a stylish heist game: noir-pop jazz-funk, 100 BPM, F minor, 4/4, steady tempo. A tight funky drum groove with brushes on the snare, a round electric bass line, Rhodes chords, a muted trumpet stating a sly five-note minor blues motif as the main hook, and a baritone sax answering it. Cool, confident and a little playful, like the opening titles of a caper film. Structure: 4-bar groove, 8 bars with the trumpet hook, 8 bars where the sax and trumpet trade phrases, then back to the top. No intro, no ending, no fade: it must loop seamlessly. Instrumental only, no vocals. No electronic beats, no synths.
